title: Final Expression for v^2
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and state the expression v^2 = (∂p/∂ρ)_S.

title: Final Expression for v
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly compute and state the expression for sound speed v in the system of spin 1/2 particles.

title: Use of Continuity Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the continuity equation in the derivation of sound wave speed.

title: Use of Momentum Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the momentum equation in the derivation of sound wave speed.

title: Assumption Justification
description: Optional Criteria: The student should mention the assumption of adiabatic processes for the derivation.

title: Correct Units
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all derived expressions have consistent and correct units.

title: Neglect of Viscosity
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should acknowledge the neglect of viscosity and heat conductivity in their derivation.
